transcript.answer: Otto PR #475, "Hand the resolved fallback to HAL Engine, and refuse fallbacks it cannot serve". It was merged on 2026-10-23 and closes issue #474. Before it, #179 (PR #438) only validated FALLBACK_MODEL_ID and printed it in the api.model startup line. The fallback never reached the engine, because buildEngine passed no fallbackProviders. PR #475 added supportAgentProviders(config) in apps/api/src/server.ts. It returns the resolved fallback as fallbackProviders, or an empty list when FALLBACK_MODEL_ID is unset. buildEngine spreads that into createHalEngine.
